span.label: The intra-mPFC microinjection procedure itself, and whether repeating it is compatible with studying extinction learning.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: repeated cannula and injector insertion destroys tissue in Layers I-III of the mPFC on both sides of the midline, removing projection neurons that normally regulate the nucleus accumbens and basolateral amygdala, and the loss of that top-down regulation is what blocks extinction learning
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: cumulative mechanical damage from implantation plus repeated infusions amounts to a partial lesion of a region already shown to be necessary for extinction, so the injection itself reproduces the lesion effect regardless of what is infused
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The vehicle group could not serve as the control, because whatever impaired extinction affected vehicle and drug alike
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Only a group that never had the procedure could reveal it, which is why the no-surgery control was added in the second experiment
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The proposed cause: the repeated procedure damages the very region it is delivering into, amounting to a partial lesion
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Because the cannula sat on the midline, the damage was bilateral rather than confined to one hemisphere
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The damaged layers contain projection neurons to accumbens and amygdala whose activity changes with drug cues, which is a route from local damage to the behavioural failure
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Surgery and anaesthesia were ruled out by comparison with their own earlier study matched on strain, frame, coordinates, anaesthesia and surgeon
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The planned within-subject comparisons were run regardless of the interaction and are acknowledged as not statistically justified.
span.note: what this limits: every within-subject comparison reported: THIS METHOD OF ANALYSIS, ALTHOUGH NOT STATISTICALLY JUSTIFIED, WAS IMPLEMENTED BECAUSE OF THE NARROW DETECTION WINDOW AND INCREASED VARIABILITY inherent to the paradigm
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The proposed explanation via damage to mPFC projection neurons is untested and needs confirmation.
span.note: what this limits: the projection-damage explanation: FURTHER EXAMINATION OF THE EFFECTS OF THE MICROINJECTION PROCEDURE ON THESE SPECIFIC PROJECTIONS ... IS REQUIRED - proposed, not tested
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: As performed, the microinjection procedure cannot be used to test intra-mPFC pharmacological manipulations of EtOH-CPP extinction.
span.note: what this limits: any pharmacological use of this procedure: IRRESPECTIVE OF HOW EACH COMPONENT ... CONTRIBUTES TO THE OBSERVED EFFECT, AS CURRENTLY PERFORMED, THIS PROCEDURE IS NOT ADEQUATELY SUITED TO EXAMINE THE EFFECTS OF INTRA-mPFC PHARMACOLOGICAL MANIPULATIONS ON EXTINCTION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The authors state that their own analysis is not statistically justified, and say why they used it anyway
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[0] · what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - the within-subject comparisons are acknowledged as not statistically justified, with the reason given
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Animals were removed for failing to acquire a preference and for histology, about a third of each experiment
span.note: what this limits: the sample behind Experiment 1: A TOTAL OF 18 ANIMALS WERE REMOVED FROM ANALYSIS (9 SHOWED LESS THAN 50% PREFERENCE ON TEST 1 AND AN ADDITIONAL 9 WERE REMOVED FOR NOT MEETING HISTOLOGICAL CRITERIA)
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Non-learners were excluded by an a priori rule, which is disclosed and defended by reference to prior practice
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 4, with the rule and its justification: WE DECIDED, A PRIORI, TO REMOVE ANIMALS THAT FAILED TO EXPRESS A PLACE PREFERENCE OF GREATER THAN 50% ON TEST 1
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The strongest extra evidence - doubling extinction to six days - is reported as data not shown
span.note: what this limits: the strongest supporting evidence for the extinction claim, which is not shown: DESPITE DOUBLING THE NUMBER OF EXTINCTION TRIALS, WE FOUND THAT BOTH mPFC-INJECTED GROUPS CONTINUED TO EXHIBIT IMPAIRED EXTINCTION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The damage-to-projection account is offered as conceivable and explicitly not established
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 1 - the damage-to-projection account is offered as conceivable and explicitly not established
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: No group-by-test interaction reached significance in either experiment, so the key contrast rests on the planned within-group comparisons
span.note: what this limits: the central group contrast: THE INITIAL 2-WAY ANOVA REVEALED A MAIN EFFECT OF TEST [F(1,40) = 9.3, p < .005] BUT NOT GROUP, AND NO SIGNIFICANT GROUP x TEST INTERACTION (p's > .05), so the effect rests on the planned comparisons
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: an additional group given NO SURGERY AT ALL (the No Sx group), alongside the vehicle-infused and drug-infused groups
span.note: eliminates: the handling involved in the microinjection procedure - being restrained and manipulated - as the cause of the change in extinction learning, which a vehicle control alone cannot separate because it is handled too
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: critiques → the repeated intra-mPFC microinjection procedure as a tool for multi-day extinction studies
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS THE NUMBER OF INJECTIONS, AND MINIMISING IT DOES NOT HELP. 'the damage caused by intra-mPFC injections EVEN WHEN THE NUMBER OF INJECTIONS WAS MINIMIZED, was sufficient enough to impair extinction - an effect that PERSISTED DESPITE EXTENDED EXTINCTION TRAINING.' The critique of the procedure is dosed: it survives the obvious remedy. Q-444.

span.label: Neither the bupivacaine group nor its vehicle-injected control extinguished ethanol place preference, so the intended pharmacological comparison was uninterpretable.

span.label: In the second experiment only the group that never underwent surgery showed a reliable drop in place preference, isolating the surgery/injection procedure rather than the drug as the cause.

span.label: Because a no-surgery control that received the same handling did extinguish, the disruption is attributable to the microinjection procedure itself and not to the stress of being handled.

span.label: Extending extinction training to six days did not rescue extinction in either injected group, showing the impairment is persistent rather than a matter of insufficient training.
